sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be favored against struggling Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, providing an opportunity for the chasing pack to close the gap. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, entertain Eccleshall—who sit fifth with 18 points—in what shapes as a key fixture for both sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community on Saturday before meeting Brereton Social at home on Wednesday evening. In-form Bilston Town (17 points, currently on a run of consecutive wins) host Foley Meir, while struggling Shawbury United—on an alarming six-game losing streak—face Barnton at home. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a match between two of the division's lowest scorers, Market Drayton Town host New Mills, and Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in what should prove a closely-fought encounter given both sides' mid-table positioning. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home on Saturday; Widnes remain without a win this season and sit rock-bottom with just 2 points.
